description: Ministry of Water Supply and Estate  Infrastructure Development - Amended Extra Gazette No 2261/33 Dated 05.01.2022 (National Water Supply and Drainage Board)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with a land-related matter. It is an order under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act to amend the official description of a specific land parcel, including its extent (from 25 to 11 perches) and its boundaries as described in a survey plan. The content focuses on property description and land registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). While a government minister is named, the core subject is land/property, not government structure, personnel, or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
